problem: A compact authoritative STM32/CAN placement cannot reuse proof-era grid copper: dense LQFP/SOIC pad rows, regulator pads, headers, and explicit GND vias block direct Manhattan trunks.
rootCause: Routing was attempted before authoritative placement and without treating accepted nets as immutable occupancy. Adjacent CAN_TX/CAN_RX escapes and the four-endpoint CANH/CANL trees require ordered, package-aware fanout.
solution: Route transactionally in the order 5V, CAN_TX, I2C_SDA, explicit GND, CAN_RX, CANH, CANL. Use a B.Cu dogleg for CAN_RX, a B.Cu upper perimeter tree for CANH, and an In1.Cu y=35 outer tree for CANL. Escape CANL R1.2 at (20.8,26.925), D1.2 at (34.5,27.438), and route U2.6 around U3 to the via at (38,13.2).
